reviews.title: App says 7day free trial. It’s not.
reviews.text:
When the app suggests a free trial, it says that it’s 7 days. But when I went into my Apple subscriptions it says 3 days.

I listened to two meditations and loved it. But $11/weekly is steep and a 3 day trial is not enough to decide if it’s effective.
